column1: # Reader codes used in this folder's transcriptions (key.tsv, ciphertext_2039_legend.tsv, ciphertext_2061_battery.tsv)
# mapped to the period sheet's signs (key_period.tsv). GAPS13-na-suriname-map-1781, 2 Oct 2026. The transcriptions'
# blind readers named signs by look-alike Latin letters, often lowercase for the sheet's script capitals; the identity
# code -> sheet sign is by shape name, not by an image comparison. Grade H where the code is the sheet's own
# character (digits, Greek, #, the sheet's lowercase letters) or where an independently derived value (key.tsv grade C
# or the 2061 cribs) equals the period value for that sign (known-answer agreement); M where the identity rests on
# shape name alone or the code covers two sheet signs (value a|b). Codes not listed stay unkeyed (U): [u-dots],
# [w-tilde], [MM], [ladder-III] etc. are not on the alphabet side; the verso's code-group list may hold them.
